prompt: How many solutions does the equation $8(x - 5) = -2(x + 20)$ have?
explanation: Choice A is correct. Distributing $8$ on the left-hand side and $-2$ on the right-hand side of the given equation yields $8x - 40 = -2x - 40$. Adding $2x$ to each side of this equation yields $10x - 40 = -40$. Adding $40$ to each side of this equation yields $10x = 0$. Dividing each side of this equation by $10$ yields $x = 0$. This means that $0$ is the only solution to the given equation. Therefore, the given equation has exactly one solution.
